item.content:encoded:
Nice article! Thouh I'd have to agree that there's not enough buildup to the final entry for it to really make an impact.
Also, this line:
"However, they were completely baffles when they forced the door open to reveal a nearly empty room."

Shouldn't that "baffles" be corrected to "baffled"?

Other than that, I like the vibe you're going for.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Very good point. I guess I would've liked it more if it weren't Parawatch; more of a Twilight Zone-esque event. Tried to hone in on the more paranormal part rather than horror, but this complaint makes a very valid point in how short it is. Thanks for the read, though!
